description: This file defines the `OrderProductDownload` entity class, mapped to a database table, representing downloadable products associated with an order product in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: OrderProductDownload
classes.description: Entity class representing downloadable content for an order product, including download limits and file information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this download record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this download record.

methods.name: getOrderProduct
methods.description: Returns the order product associated with this download.

methods.name: setOrderProduct
methods.description: Sets the order product associated with this download.

methods.name: getOrderProductFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the downloadable product.

methods.name: setOrderProductFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the downloadable product.

methods.name: getMaxdays
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed download days.

methods.name: setMaxdays
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed download days.

methods.name: getDownloadCount
methods.description: Returns the current count of downloads.

methods.name: setDownloadCount
methods.description: Sets the current count of downloads.
